purpose: Local source-router registry for proposal-only source recommendations during skill-sync runs.

bundles.title: Robotics force/torque sensor sources
bundles.recommended_when: The session discusses force/torque sensors, WrenchStamped data, robot contact force measurement, ATI Net F/T, Bota, SCHUNK, Robotiq, or ROS2 force/torque broadcasting.

sources.title: ros2_control Force Torque Sensor Broadcaster
sources.trust_rule: Use as the first ROS 2 interface baseline for publishing force/torque state interfaces as WrenchStamped; verify ROS distro and controller version before operational guidance.
sources.notes: Includes sensor_filter_chain support in current rolling docs.

sources.title: ATI Net F/T ROS driver
sources.trust_rule: Treat ros-drivers as a major ROS organization source, not ATI official; verify ROS version and protocol support before recommending it for a current ROS 2 stack.
sources.notes: Useful baseline for ATI NET/FT RDT over Ethernet; not a universal ATI SDK replacement.

sources.title: Bota FT Stack
sources.trust_rule: Use Bota docs and Botasys GitLab as official; verify generation, communication interface, and ROS2 package version before local hardware instructions.
sources.notes: Bota docs cover C++, Python, and ROS2 driver paths.

sources.title: SCHUNK force torque sensor ROS2 driver
sources.trust_rule: Treat SCHUNK-SE-Co-KG GitHub as official; verify sensor model, Ethernet interface box, and lifecycle behavior before use.
sources.notes: Official ROS2 driver for SCHUNK FTS hardware.

sources.title: Robotiq force torque ROS sources
sources.trust_rule: Use ROS wiki and ros-industrial as historical/major-org context; keep small ROS2 drivers as community sources unless vendor ownership is verified.
sources.notes: Good for discovery and legacy behavior, not a default modern ROS2 recommendation without local validation.

bundles.notes: Source recommendations are proposal-only; physical sensor setup still needs local electrical, transport, frame, calibration, and safety validation.

bundles.title: Robotics sensor noise filtering sources
bundles.recommended_when: The session discusses filtering noisy sensor data, WrenchStamped smoothing, low-pass filters, Butterworth filters, ROS filter chains, or force/torque signal processing.

sources.title: ROS filters
sources.trust_rule: Use as the standard ROS filter-chain API baseline; verify ROS distro support and plugin availability before implementation guidance.
sources.notes: Provides a standardized interface for chaining filters from runtime parameters.

sources.title: ros2_control filter-chain integration
sources.trust_rule: Use for ROS2 controller-level filtering proposals; verify controller version and filter plugin configuration before code changes.
sources.notes: ForceTorqueSensorBroadcaster supports sensor_filter_chain; Chained Filter Controller wraps filter_chain for controller interfaces.

sources.title: SciPy signal processing
sources.role: offline analysis and filter design reference
sources.trust_rule: Use for offline filter design, log analysis, and parameter exploration; do not treat SciPy examples as real-time robot control guidance without latency and stability validation.
sources.notes: Useful for Butterworth/IIR/FIR analysis before translating parameters into ROS runtime filters.

bundles.notes: Prefer ROS runtime filter chains for deployed robot paths and SciPy for offline analysis or parameter design.
